Workflow.Name: VISITES - Génération Fichier DEP (PAD)
Workflow.Definition:
"@@ConnectionString: ''
@@Type: 'Local'
@@DesktopType: 'local'
@@DisplayName: 'Ordinateur local'
IMPORT 'controlRepo.appmask' AS appmask
IMPORT 'imageRepo.imgrepo' AS imgrepo
@SENSITIVE: [ExcelFilePassword]
@INPUT ExcelFilePassword : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'ExcelFilePassword', 'Type': 'String', 'IsOptional': False, 'DefaultValue': 'MDPDEP' } 
@INPUT Visite : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'Visite', 'Type': 'CustomObject', 'IsOptional': False, 'DefaultValue': {{ }} } 
@INPUT Ménage : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'Ménage', 'Type': 'CustomObject', 'IsOptional': False, 'DefaultValue': {{ }} } 
@INPUT Site : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'Site', 'Type': 'CustomObject', 'IsOptional': False, 'DefaultValue': {{ }} } 
@INPUT Référent : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'Référent', 'Type': 'CustomObject', 'IsOptional': False, 'DefaultValue': {{ }} } 
@INPUT Alerte : { 'Description': '', 'FriendlyName': 'Alerte', 'Type': 'CustomObject', 'IsOptional': False, 'DefaultValue': {{ }} } 
File.Copy Files: $'''C:\\Users\\YoanVANDERSPURT\\Downloads\\DEP pour démat.xlsx''' Destination: $'''C:\\Users\\YoanVANDERSPURT\\Downloads\\temp''' IfFileExists: File.IfExists.Overwrite CopiedFiles=> CopiedFiles
Excel.LaunchExcel.LaunchAndOpenUnderExistingProcess Path: CopiedFiles[0]['FullName'] Visible: True ReadProtectionPassword: ExcelFilePassword ReadOnly: False WriteProtectionPassword: ExcelFilePassword Instance=> ExcelInstance
CALL Unlock_File
CALL Write_to_File
Excel.CloseExcel.CloseAndSave Instance: ExcelInstance
FUNCTION Write_to_File GLOBAL
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''DATE''' Column: $'''B''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''HEURE''' Column: $'''C''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''CHARGE''' Column: $'''D''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''MOTIF''' Column: $'''E''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''DONNEUR''' Column: $'''F''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''CIVILITE''' Column: $'''G''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''NOM''' Column: $'''H''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''PRENOM''' Column: $'''I''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''DATENAISSANCE''' Column: $'''J''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''PORTABLE''' Column: $'''K''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''FIXE''' Column: $'''L''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''EMAIL''' Column: $'''M''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''ADRESSE''' Column: $'''N''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''COMPLEMENT''' Column: $'''O''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''CODEPOSTAL''' Column: $'''P''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''COMMUNE''' Column: $'''Q''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''LIEU DIT''' Column: $'''R''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''OCCUPANTS''' Column: $'''S''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''CATEGORIE''' Column: $'''T''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''REVENU''' Column: $'''U''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''PARTS''' Column: $'''V''' Row: 3
 Excel.WriteToExcel.WriteCell Instance: ExcelInstance Value: $'''TYPE LOGEMENT''' Column: $'''W''' Row: 3
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION Unlock_File GLOBAL
 UIAutomation.SelectTab Tab: appmask['Window \'DEP pour démat - Excel\'']['Tab Item \'Entrées\'']
 UIAutomation.SelectMenuOption Control: appmask['Window \'DEP pour démat - Excel\'']['Menu Item \'Tapez pour rechercher et utilisez les touches fléchées vers le haut et vers le bas pour naviguer.\'']
 UIAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextField TextField: appmask['Window \'DEP pour démat - Excel\'']['Edit \'Recherche Microsoft \''] Text: 'pro' Mode: UIAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace ClickType: UIAutomation.PopulateMouseClickType.SingleClick
 UIAutomation.SelectMenuOption Control: appmask['Window \'DEP pour démat - Excel\'']['MenuItem: Tapez pour ... Protéger la feuille']
 UIAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextField TextField: appmask['Window \'Ôter la protection de la feuille\'']['Edit \'Mot de passe \''] Text: ExcelFilePassword Mode: UIAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace ClickType: UIAutomation.PopulateMouseClickType.SingleClick
 UIAutomation.PressButton Button: appmask['Window \'Ôter la protection de la feuille\'']['Button \'OK\'']
END FUNCTION
"
